title: Krea AI Pricing: Plans, Compute Units & Limits in 2026
summary: Krea AI pricing structures vary by generation speed, resolution, and concurrent task limits. Compare these subscription tiers to select the right plan.
body_markdown:
## Krea AI credits and generation speeds


By differentiating between compute priority and model-specific quotas, Krea AI couples throughput to subscription tiers.


While seat-based licensing determines the baseline entry price for teams, the actual utility of the platform is governed by how the system allocates GPU resources between instant visual feedback and high-fidelity final outputs.


### How fast generations and flux credits work


Fast mode gives immediate access to the GPU cluster. You'll avoid the processing queues that delay production during peak hours. A credit system consumes this priority. Complex models, specifically those utilizing the Flux architecture, require a higher per-generation spend than standard latent consistency models.


When users move from a metered environment to the unconstrained Relaxed mode available on higher tiers, the scale of output changes significantly.


The data shows that the Basic plan imposes a hard ceiling on monthly output. This creates a production bottleneck once the initial credit pool is exhausted.


### Krea AI relaxed mode unlimited generations


Conversely, Enterprise plans include unlimited relaxed generations at a lower priority. A designer can explore thousands of variations without triggering an overage charge or a mid-month service suspension.


This transition from capped to uncapped utility allows teams to shift from cautious, deliberate prompting to a high-volume exploratory workflow.


### The hidden limits of the Real-time Enhancer


To upscale and refine images as you move your cursor, the Real-time Enhancer utilizes a persistent stream of compute. This process necessitates a stable, high-bandwidth connection to the Krea AI servers.


Because this tool operates on a live loop rather than a discrete "submit" action, it can consume Fast mode minutes rapidly if you don't manually toggle the quality settings.


A single afternoon of active design on the Basic tier can deplete a week’s worth of credits. This depletion effectively locks you out of other generation tools until the next billing cycle.


### Video generation costs for Pro and Max users


Because video production requires significantly more VRAM than static imagery, Krea AI tiers these capabilities to prevent lower-cost accounts from monopolizing the video rendering pipeline.


Pro users receive a dedicated allocation for video, but the Max plan is the only tier that has the throughput necessary for generating high-frame-rate cinematic clips at scale.


Krea AI has a predictable cost structure for video through its subscription tiers. Luma Dream Machine utilizes a credit-based system that can fluctuate based on the complexity of the motion required.


### Krea AI video upscaling costs


For teams producing high volumes of short-form content, Krea AI’s "Video Enhancer" upscales existing footage without the per-second surcharges found in Luma Dream Machine.


This allows a studio to iterate on a single scene dozens of times without hitting a hard ceiling on their monthly experimentation budget.


The Max plan pays for itself for a studio producing social media assets by removing the "generation-at-a-time" queue. This allows multiple video projects to render in parallel so that deadlines are met without manual intervention.
